screens.name: editor-never
steps: Open the folder C:\lab\pl01 (code C:\lab\pl01), dark theme, font size 18 or larger
Run 'TypeScript: Select TypeScript Version' > 'Use Workspace Version' (6.0.x from node_modules/typescript)
Open demo/unsafe.ts and scroll to the badge function (lines 22 to 33)
Open the Problems panel (Ctrl+Shift+M) so the other errors are listed
Hover assertNever(state) on line 31 until the tooltip shows: Argument of type '{ readonly kind: "rejected"; ... }' is not assignable to parameter of type 'never'
Hold the frame for about 5 seconds
mask: window title bar and Explorer root if they show a user name or a full path
